name: Action Electronics, Inc.
old_description: At Action Electronics, we harness the power of innovative technology and draw on our award-winning industry expertise. We strive to deliver personalized, value-added services that keep your processes running seamlessly and effectively.
about:
Action Electronics, Inc. operates from a 9,000-square-foot warehouse in Walpole, Massachusetts. The company has built 30 years of operational excellence in supply chain solutions, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides integrated supply chain services including procurement consolidation, kitting and packaging, mil-spec packaging, inventory management, strategic sourcing, temporary labor and contractor services, security services, custom delivery, fulfillment, complex kit builds, premium packaging, shrink-wrapping, in-chain packaging, product configuration, and OEM-ready hardware kit assembly. Its ISO 9001-qualified facility runs 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and ships over one million pieces annually.

Action Electronics serves the aerospace and defense and telecommunications industries. Its customer base includes federal, state, and local government entities, military contractors, and all branches of the U.S. military.

The company emphasizes its around-the-clock operation, three decades of experience, full certification, high-volume shipping capacity, deep aerospace and defense expertise, and tailored solutions crafted to specific requirements as key differentiators. Its stated mission is to harness innovative technology and award-winning industry expertise to deliver personalized, value-added services that keep customer processes running seamlessly.
